# @37bytes/code-style

> Unified linting and formatting toolkit for 37bytes projects. Provides modular ESLint flat configs (spa, nextjs, nodejsRuntime, nodejsTool), custom ESLint plugins, Stylelint config for CSS/SCSS modules, Prettier config, TypeScript base configs, EditorConfig, and optional OxLint/Biome mirror configs with hybrid mode support.

This package is an all-in-one code quality toolkit. ESLint is the source of truth; OxLint and Biome are optional mirrors. Application-type configs (spa, nextjs, nodejsRuntime, nodejsTool) compose from granular rule sets (javascript, typescript, react, imports, node, quality, regexp, and more). Bootstrap-phase code is handled via the `nodejsConfig` override-object which consumers apply through flat-config files-glob to env-loaders, server entry-points, build scripts, etc. Custom @37bytes ESLint plugins enforce project-specific conventions: no-browser-storage, no-arrow-props, boolean-naming, and enum-pattern. A whitelist approach is used for all third-party rules (no blind `recommended` presets).

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/README.md): installation, usage examples, available rules and configs, custom plugin docs, Prettier/TypeScript/EditorConfig setup
- [Naming Conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/NAMING_CONVENTIONS.md): JavaScript, TypeScript, and React naming standards enforced by the toolkit
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/CHANGELOG.md): all notable changes, organized by tool (ESLint, OxLint, Biome, Prettier, TypeScript)

## Configuration

- [ESLint Main Config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/eslint/config.js): app configs (spa, nextjs, nodejsRuntime, nodejsTool), bootstrap-override (nodejsConfig), Next.js server-side override (nextjsServerConfig), opt-in layers, perfectionist namespace
- [ESLint Entry Point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/eslint/index.js): main export re-exporting configs, rules, and plugins
- [ESLint Rules Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/eslint/rules/index.js): re-exports all rule sets (javascript, typescript, browser, react, imports, node, quality, regexp, testing, storybook, nextjs, perfectionist)
- [ESLint Plugins Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/eslint/plugins/index.js): aggregates custom @37bytes rules
- [Stylelint Config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/stylelint/config.js): CSS/SCSS modules config (property ordering, lowerCamelCase selectors, CSS variable enforcement)
- [Prettier Config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/prettier/config.js): shared Prettier settings (120 width, 4-space indent, single quotes, no trailing commas)
- [TypeScript Base Config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/typescript/base.json): strict base tsconfig (ES2023)
- [TypeScript React Config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/typescript/react.json): React app tsconfig (DOM types, JSX)
- [TypeScript Node Config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/typescript/node.json): Node.js tsconfig (NodeNext modules)
- [OxLint Config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/oxlint/config.json): generated OxLint config (303 base rules + overrides)
- [Biome Config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/37bytes/code-style/master/biome/config.json): generated Biome v2 config (~125 rules + overrides)
